name: Sting
description:
Your Colony lashes out at an adjacent creature with stings and bites, dealing 1 damage. Roll Spirit vs Fortitude against the creature. On a win, the creature takes -1 Defense, up to a maximum of -3 Defense from this Ability.

Describe how you command your Colony.
successes:
✨: Win or lose, the creature takes 1d4 damage.

🌞: On a win, the creature takes an additional -1 Defense and checks a Condition.
